key_insight: CoopUQ improves multi-robot social navigation by combining cooperative occupancy forecasts with uncertainty-aware risk penalties.
engineering_relevance: Sharing predictive information across robots can support safer navigation around people when occlusions or unfamiliar conditions undermine individual perception.
method: Fuse spatiotemporal features across robots to forecast future occupancy grids.
Estimate forecast uncertainty alongside predicted occupancy.
Train navigation policies with constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning that penalizes occupied or highly uncertain regions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved prediction and safety over representative baselines in Unity3D simulations spanning in-distribution and OOD conditions, plus robustness demonstrations on real robots.
watch_item: Deployment should assess communication latency and failures, whose effects on cooperative forecasting are not specified in the abstract.
paper_title: CoopUQ: Robust Multi-Robot Social Navigation via Uncertainty-Aware Cooperative Forecasting
